book.title: Kristiyan Lenji Vakatha Va I Vivako Utuniye Luk Le Rorori

content: Pita i wa weya Koniliyos
Amala regha idae Koniliyos, va i yaku Sisariya. Iye Rom ragagaithɨ wabwi laghɨye regha lenji randeviva thɨ rakamena Itali.
Mbaŋake wolaghɨye i mando na i vakatha budakai i vawarariŋa Loi na i kururuwe. Le ŋgoloko gharayakuyaku tembe ŋgoreiyeva. Na vambe i thalavu wagiyaweŋgiva mbinyembinyeŋgu na i naŋgo valaŋa weya Loi.
Mbaŋa regha tɨri klok yeghɨyeghɨye, vavaghare regha i yomarawe. Va i thuwe wagiyaweya Loi le nyao thovuye regha, i mena na i dagewe iŋa, “Koniliyos.”

Koniliyos i vonjimbughathɨ weiye le mararu laghɨye na iŋa, “Ŋgoroŋga Giyana?” Nyaoko thovuye i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Len naŋgona na len thalavu weŋgiya mbinyembinyeŋgu, thiyake ŋgoreiya vowo thovuye na Loi i warari kaiwae.
E mbaŋake iyake u variyeŋgiya ghɨmoghɨmoru vavana na vethɨ vaŋgwa amala regha idae Saimon ina Jopa, idae regha thɨ uno Pita.
Mbe ina i yaku weiye le ghaida Saimon, iye i vakavakatha bigibigi vavana thetheghan e njimwanji, na i yaku e njighɨ ghadidiye.”
Mbaŋa nyaoma thovuye me utuutukowe kaero i wa, amba Koniliyos i kula vathaŋgiya le ŋgoloko gharakakaiwo theghewo na gharathalavu thovuye regha ragagaithɨko e tɨnenji. Iye i kururu weya Loi.
I utugiyavao weŋgi budakai me yomarawe amba i variyeŋgi na thɨ wa Jopa.
Mbaŋa theghewoniye e tɨne kaero thɨ vurɨthaiya ghemba, na mbala vama i wo ghararaghɨye mboro, Pita i voro e ŋgolo vwatae naŋgo kaiwae.
Ghare i basi na nuwaiya i ghanɨŋga, na mbaŋa vamba thɨ vakavakatha ghanɨŋga amba vavaghare regha i yomarawe.
I thuwe buruburu i mavu na bigi regha ŋgoreiya kwama laghɨye yaŋgara i kwate njama, ŋgoreiye thɨ yalawe e mbothiye theghevarɨ.
Thetheghan gheghenji gɨgɨvarɨ, thetheghan thɨ liya gharenji vwatae e thelau na ma thɨ yoyo e buruburu na yambaneke ghanjilughawoghawo vavana va inanji e tɨne.
Amba ghalɨghalɨŋa regha i dagewe iŋa, “Pita, u thuweiru, u gaboŋgiya thetheghanɨke thiyake na u ghanɨŋgi.”
Pita i gonjogha iŋa, “Ma valɨkaiwae, Giyana! Ma mbaŋa regha ya ghanɨŋgiya thetheghan ŋgoranjiyako kaiwae Mosese le mbaro i dageten weime.”
Ghalɨghalɨŋama mbowo i dageweva mbaŋaiwoniye iŋa, “The bigiya Loi va iŋa i thɨna, thava uŋa ma i thɨna.”
Ghalɨghalɨŋa mbaŋato i njama weya Pita, amba kwamako i kwate njogha e buruburu.
Pita vamba i rerenuwaŋa ŋgoroŋga vavaghareko gharumwaru, gharɨgharɨma Koniliyos menda i variyeŋgima na thɨ tamwetamweya Saimon le ŋgolo, kaero thɨ ndendeghathɨ e ghamba ru.
Thɨ kula ru thɨŋa, “Saimon, idae regha Pita ina ghena?”
Pita vamba i rerenuwaŋa vara vavaghareko kaiwae, kaero Nyao Boboma i dagewe iŋa, “Pita, ghɨmoghɨmoru thegheto thɨ tamwetamwe e ghen.
U yondovirɨ na u nja bode, na thava u numoghegheiwo, ma u wa eŋge weinaŋgi, kaiwae ghino menda ya variyeŋgi.”
Pita i nja na i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Ghino iya hu tamweŋgona. Buda kaiwae mohu mena weŋgo?”

Thɨ gonjoghawe thɨŋa, “Koniliyos menda i variyeime, iye ragagaithɨ wabwi laghɨye regha lenji randeviva. Iye lolo rumwarumwaruniye na i kururu weya Loi, na Jiu gharɨgharɨniye thɨ yavwatatawana. Loi le nyao thovuye regha menda i dagewe na valɨkaiwae i kula e ghen na vo ru ele ŋgolo mbala i vandeŋe budakaiya ne u utuwe.”
Amba Pita i kula ruwoŋgi na thɨ ghena weinji gougou regha. Mbaŋambaŋava Pita na ghauneko me ghenako weiyaŋgi thɨ wareri weinjiyaŋgiya raloŋweloŋweghathɨ vavana Jopa e tɨne.
Mbaŋambaŋa vena amba vethɨ vutha Sisariya. Koniliyos vama i roroghagha weŋgi na ma i kula vathaŋgiya le bodaboda na le vɨghathɨ moli vavana na mbema vethɨ yaku vara ele ŋgolo thɨ roroghagha weŋgi.
Mbaŋa Pita i vutha na mbalama i ru vara, Koniliyos i lavolevole, i ronja e gheghe vuvuye na i kururuwe.
Ko iyemaeŋge Pita i mwanavairɨ njogha na i dagewe iŋa, “Wo u yondovirɨ! Ghino mbema lolokeni, ŋgoraŋgwa ghen!”
Pita weiye Koniliyos thɨ layo utuutu na thɨ ru e ŋgoloko tɨne i vaidiŋgiya gharɨgharɨ lemoyo kaero thɨ mevathavatha e ŋgoloko tɨne.

Amba i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Kaero hu ghareghare, ghime Jiu lama kururu ghambaro i dageten weime na ma valɨkaiwame weimaŋgiya ghemi ma Jiu gharɨgharɨniye ra wabwi na regha. Iyemaeŋge Loi kaero mendava i vatomwe e ghino ma valɨkaiwae yaŋa lolo regha ma i thɨna.
Iya kaiwae mbaŋa mendava u variya utu kaiwaŋgu ma ya botewo, mbema ya mena eŋge. Wo u utugiyama e ghino len rɨghe budakai na u variya utu kaiwaŋgu?”

Koniliyos i gonjoghawe iŋa, “Mbaŋa theghevarɨ kaero iko, va ya naŋgonaŋgo elo ŋgoloke, mbaŋa ghalughawoghawo ŋgoreiya mbaŋake iyake, tɨri klok yeghɨyeghɨye. Mbaŋako vara iyako amala regha, ghakwama marambwelambwelawae, i ndeghathɨ e ghamwaŋgu.
I dage e ghino iŋa, ‘Koniliyos, len naŋgona Loi kaero i loŋwe na i warari len thalavu weŋgiya mbinyembinyeŋgu kaiwae.

Iya kaiwae mbaŋake iyake u variyeŋgiya gharɨgharɨ vavana Jopa na vethɨ vaŋgwa Saimon, idae regha thɨŋa Pita. Iye bobwari, ina le ghaida Saimon ele ŋgolo, iye i vakavakatha bigibigi thetheghan e njimwanji. Le ŋgolo ina e njighɨ ghadidiye.’

E mbaŋako iyako ya variyeŋgiya lo rakakaiwo na thɨ ghaona kaiwan. Ago laghɨye kaiwae ghen maiyake. E mbaŋake iyake taulaghɨke ghime wo mevathavatha Loi e marae mbala wo vandeŋe budakaiya Giya le wogiya e ghen u utuŋa weime.”
Pita i vavaghare Koniliyos ele ŋgolo tɨne
Amba Pita i woraweya le utuutu rɨghe iŋa, “Ya ghareghare emunjoru gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye mboromboroŋgi Loi e marae.
Iya kaiwae i wovatha gharɨgharɨ e vanautumake wolaghɨye, thavala thɨ yavwatatawana na ghanjithanavu i rumwaru Loi e marae.

Kaero hu ghareghare Totoke Thovuye Loi va i variyeke weŋgiya Isirel gharɨgharɨniye. I vatomwe weinda valɨkaiwae ra vaidiya vanevane weya Loi mbaŋa ra loŋweghathɨgha Jisas Krais. Na iye gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye ghanji Giya.
Kaero hu ghareghare Jisas le vakatha Judiya laghɨyeko e tɨne, va i woraweya rɨghe Galili mbaŋa Jon Rabapɨtaiso i wora le vavaghare rɨghe e ghereiye.

Kaero hu ghareghare Loi va i liŋgiya Nyao Boboma weya Jisas Krais rara Nasaret na i wo vurɨgheghe, amba i vaghɨliya na i vakathaŋgiya vakatha thovuthovuye, na i thawariŋgiya thiye thɨ ghataŋa vɨrɨ Seitan le vurɨgheghe i laweghathɨŋgi, kaiwae Loi va inawe.”
“Bigibigike wolaghɨye va i vakathaŋgi Judiya laghɨyeko e tɨne na tembe ŋgoreiyeva Jerusalem, ghime va wo thuwe e marame na wo utuŋa. Va thɨ wovakwate e kros vwatae na thɨ tagavamarawe,
ko iyemaeŋge mbaŋa theghetoniye e tɨne Loi kaero i vaŋguthuweiruva mare e tɨne na i vakatha i raŋgiraŋgi weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ na thɨ thuwe kaero i yawayawaliyeva.
Ko mava i raŋgiraŋgi weŋgiya gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye, mbe ghime eŋge iyava Loi i tuthimeke na wo ndethɨna utuniye, na le thuweiru e ghereiye wo ghanɨŋga na wo munumu weime.

Va i dage weime na wo vavaghareŋa Totoke Thovuye iyake weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ e valɨvaŋgake wolaghɨye na wo utugiya weŋgi iye Jisas Loi va i tuthi na iye i ghathaŋgiya thavala mbe e yawayawalinji na thiye ramaremare.
Loi ghalɨŋae gharautu tevambe thɨ utuŋava Jisas utuniye, iyava thɨŋako thavala thɨ loŋweghathɨ Loi ne i numotena lenji tharɨ amalaghɨniye e idae.”
Nyao Boboma i nja weŋgiya thiye ma Jiu
Pita vamba i utuutu kaero Nyao Boboma i nja weŋgiya gharɨgharɨko wolaghɨye iyava thɨ vandeŋe le vavaghareko.
Thiye Jiu raloŋweloŋweghathɨ iya menda weinjima Pita thɨ ri Jopa gharenji i yo kaiwae Loi tembe i liŋgiva le mwaewo Nyao Boboma weŋgiya thiye ma Jiu.
Iyake kaiwae thɨ loŋwe thiya utu e ghalɨghalɨŋa vavanava ma thɨ ghareghare na thɨ taraweŋa Loi. Amba Pita iŋa,
“Gharɨgharɨke thiyake kaero thɨ wo Nyao Boboma ŋgoreiyeva ghinda. Iya kaiwae ma valɨkaiwae lolo regha i dagetenɨŋgi na thava thɨ bapɨtaiso e mbwa.”
Pita iŋa na thɨ bapɨtaiso Jisas Krais e idae. E ghereiye thɨ naŋgowe na wo thɨ yaku weinji mbaŋa vavana e tɨne.
